params.caption: 🎮 Square Enix sales jump 21.9% as its multi-platform push pays off Square Enix reported a 21.9% sales boost, helped by Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth and other JRPG hits. The growth comes as the publisher brings more of its games to Switch 2 and Xbox instead of keeping them on one platform. 🕒 Nov 11, 2026 · 16:03 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: GamesRadar+ #SquareEnix #FinalFantasy #GamingNews
